title: Development of a rapid sensor system for nitrate detection in water using enhanced Raman spectroscopy
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5728-5736
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08516G, Paper
Open Access

Xintao Xia, Guiyan Yang, Hongwu Tian, Fengjing Cao, Fan Luo, Daming Dong
A portable Raman spectrometer combined with enhanced attachment enables sensitive, rapid on-site nitrate detection in water, offering a simple, low-cost solution for environmental water pollution screening.
